title: French Second Republic
capsule: The French Second Republic was proclaimed in Paris on 24 February 1848 following the abdication of King Louis-Philippe, emerging from the revolutionary upheavals that swept Europe that year. Its democratic constitution of November 1848 established universal male suffrage and a directly elected president, in which election Louis-Napoléon Bonaparte won a landslide victory in December 1848. Bonaparte undermined republican institutions through the coup of 2 December 1851, reorganizing France into the Second Empire, proclaimed on 2 December 1852, extinguishing the republic after barely four years.
